about: The 1,000 most commonly prescribed medications in Medicare Part D (CMS), most common first, cross-referenced with the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines 2025 (WHO, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; essential medicines outside the top 1,000 follow), plus common over-the-counter home remedies with their store brands, with strengths and forms from RxNorm (U.S. National Library of Medicine). Built by scripts/build-medication-list.mjs.
